As discussed previously, cytokines are proteins that, in small 
amounts, aﬀ ect behavior of other cells (see Chapter 9). Th e 
injury or stress induces cytokine production. Cytokines then 
act on target cells whose behavior can result in loss of appe-
tite, fever, inﬂ ammation, and metabolic abnormalities such as
hyperglycemia and catabolism.
